eligibility: single detected photon; success modes 0..3, failure modes 4..7, sentinel modes 8..11

seed_source.usage: one compilation seed per segment of consecutive iterations on one block; the early and late anchor segments share seed index 0; the same seeds serve the simulator and hardware cases

arms.T: programmed block B/4 with its top Gram eigenvector as input (bright arm, '+')
arms.D: programmed block with a kernel vector of B as input (dark arm)
arms.F: programmed block with one sign of the top input flipped (input-sign mutation, '-')
arms.C: cocycle-free block (every entry +1) with the true top input (block mutation)
arms.N: block with the entry whose negation moves the level most negated, true top input (entry mutation)
arms.E0: programmed block with basis input 0 (null: level 1/4 for every four-term block)
arms.E1: programmed block with basis input 1 (null: level 1/4 for every four-term block)

preregistered.question: Does the compiled 12-mode mesh realize the programmed four-branch pathion block (16 independent cocycle signs, levels 3/4, 1/4 and 0.0955, 0.6545) and follow each mutation?
preregistered.inference: descriptive against numeric thresholds; report all detected modes and event denominators
preregistered.normalization: a' = (a - a_dark) / (a_anchor - a_dark); a is the success fraction of clicks in modes 0..7

decisions.admission: a_anchor >= 0.9 and a_dark <= 0.05; every segment dark within 0.03 of a_dark; early and late anchor T readings within 0.03; at most 2 of 44 repeated arm pairs differ by more than 0.03; sentinel clicks at most 0.05 of every iteration's detected events; null levels within 0.07 of 1/4 and within 0.07 of each other. A failure marks the run 'instrument not admitted'.
decisions.conformance: given admission, every T reading of the eight pathion-only blocks within 0.07 of its ideal level, both reference-block readings within it, and at most 1 of the 18 T and F readings (floor of outlier_fraction x 18) farther away; otherwise the compiled mesh does not realize the programmed block at that tolerance
decisions.mutation: given admission, each C and N reading within 0.07 of its mutated ideal level; a reading within the tolerance of the block's true top level instead shows the readout ignores that sign structure

preregistered.boundary: Conformance of programmed operator blocks to their interference law on one 12-mode mesh; the client computes every cd_core sign, so the chip does not compute the algebra.
